title: Figure 19. Path of the Blue Orb through human body endocrine diagram
description: Anatomical outline of a human body labeling endocrine organs (hypothalamus, pituitary gland, pineal gland, thyroid and parathyroid glands, thymus, breasts, adrenal glands, pancreatic islets, ovaries, adipose tissue). A blue circle and a horizontal arrow drawn across a shaded band at chest level show the orb passing right to left through the upper torso. Caption: "Figure 19. Path of the Blue Orb"; a small area near the hand is redacted under 1843(a)(2).
